results.raw: False. LILEX is Liechtenstein’s official consolidated legislation database; the HRV was published in the Liechtensteinisches Landesgesetzblatt, not via LILEX.
False. gerichtsentscheide.li is not an official publisher; Liechtenstein court decisions are published by the Landesverwaltung or official gazettes.
False. The identifier 'VGH 2024/130' cannot correspond to a judgment dated 2025-02-25, as the year in the identifier precedes the decision date.
False. LILEX is Liechtenstein’s official consolidated legislation database; it cannot publish a 2011 ordinance in 2026.
False. gerichtsentscheide.li is an unofficial, non-authoritative aggregator; the official source is the Liechtensteinische Entscheidungssammlung (LES) or Staatsgerichtshof publications.
False. The identifier 'StGH 2024/060' cannot refer to a decision dated 2025-03-25, as the year in the identifier precedes the decision date.
False. LILEX is a private database; the HRV was officially published in the Liechtensteinisches Landesgesetzblatt (LGBl. 2003 No. 70).
False. The identifier 'StGH 1998/46' is distinct from 'StGH 1998/43', so they cannot refer to the same decision.
False. The claim misidentifies the source: VGH 2024/131 is a distinct case, not the judgment VGH 2024/130 dated 25 February 2025.
False. The cited ordinance is a Liechtenstein decree; Moniteur Belge/Belgisch Staatsblad is Belgium’s official gazette and could not publish it.
False. Liechtenstein has no official Rechtsinformationssystem (RIS); its legal gazette is the Liechtensteinisches Landesgesetzblatt (LGBl).
True. The Staatsgerichtshof is Liechtenstein’s constitutional court and routinely publishes its decisions under the “StGH” designation.
